strings.en: Misty: Let me see... Mm, it came out{NEWLINE}really nice. Well, I am in it, after all.{SCROLL}But... I think... we could stand a little{NEWLINE}closer...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『现在站近一点也不晚啊……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: It’s not too late to stand{NEWLINE}closer now...
Misty: Ah! {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 小霞『刚刚你把我抱的好紧……{NEWLINE}不过……{CLEAR}我很喜欢就是了。
strings.en: Misty: You held me so tight just now...{NEWLINE}But... I liked it.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『或许咱们可以抱得更紧一些……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Maybe we could hold each{NEWLINE}other even tighter...

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0}……我的心跳的好快……
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}... My heart’s racing...

strings.zh: {VAR:FF01:200}阿金『哇哦！{VAR:FF01:100}{SCROLL}阿金『海风吹过来的感觉好棒啊！{NEWLINE}快点走爆太郎,马上就到华蓝海角了！{CLEAR}咦？那边有人？好像是……偶像！？{CLEAR}而且还抱着谁吗？
strings.en: {VAR:FF01:200}Gold: Whoa!{VAR:FF01:100}{SCROLL}Gold: The sea breeze feels awesome!{SCROLL}Hurry up, Exbo, we’re almost at{NEWLINE}Cerulean Cape!{SCROLL}Huh? Somebody’s over there? Looks{NEWLINE}like... my idol!?{SCROLL}And hugging someone?
strings.notes: Gold calls the player 偶像 Idol (Adventures). Scene follows the Misty romance photo (#182–188, male player), so no pronoun for the player here.

strings.zh: 小霞『有人过来了,{NEWLINE}他看到咱们抱在一起了……{CLEAR}啊！！！羞死人了！！！{CLEAR}赶紧走！赶紧走！
strings.en: Misty: Someone’s coming... He saw us{NEWLINE}hugging...{SCROLL}Aaah!!! This is so embarrassing!!!{NEWLINE}Let’s go! Let’s go!

strings.zh: 阿金『啊哈哈,果然是偶像。
strings.en: Gold: Ah ha ha, it really is my idol.

strings.zh: 阿金『咦？这里只有你一个人吗？{NEWLINE}我刚刚好像看到有人跟你在一起……
strings.en: Gold: Huh? Are you here all by yourself?{SCROLL}I thought I saw someone with you just{NEWLINE}now...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『啊……那个……{NEWLINE}可能是你看错了吧,哈哈。{CLEAR}话说阿金你怎么到华蓝市来了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ah... well... You must have{NEWLINE}been seeing things, ha ha.{SCROLL}Anyway, Gold, what brings you to{NEWLINE}Cerulean City?

strings.zh: 阿金『我在若叶镇待着太无聊了,{NEWLINE}就出来四处走走。{CLEAR}没想到在这遇到偶像了。{CLEAR}自从石英高原的决战之后,{CLEAR}我也一直有在锻炼精灵。{CLEAR}既然今天遇见偶像了,{CLEAR}就请跟我来一场对战,{CLEAR}检验一下我的锻炼成果吧！
strings.en: Gold: I got bored hanging around New{NEWLINE}Bark Town, so I went out wandering.{SCROLL}Didn’t think I’d run into my idol here!{SCROLL}I’ve been training my Pokémon ever{NEWLINE}since the showdown at Indigo Plateau.{SCROLL}Since I ran into you today, Idol, battle{NEWLINE}me and see how much I’ve improved!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好,就让我看看你的进步。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: OK. Let me see how much{NEWLINE}you’ve grown.

strings.zh: 阿金『真不愧是偶像啊,{NEWLINE}看来我还需要再加强锻炼才行。{CLEAR}我现在准备去别的地方看看了,{CLEAR}回头见,偶像！
strings.en: Gold: You really are my idol. Guess I{NEWLINE}need to train even harder.{SCROLL}I’m off to check out some other places.{NEWLINE}See you around, Idol!

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像你是故意让我的吧？{NEWLINE}看来我还需要再加强锻炼才行。{CLEAR}我现在准备去别的地方看看了,{CLEAR}回头见,偶像！
strings.en: Gold: Idol, you went easy on me on{NEWLINE}purpose, didn’t you?{SCROLL}Guess I need to train even harder.{SCROLL}I’m off to check out some other places.{NEWLINE}See you around, Idol!
